## Information

* [Frequently Asked Questions](https://github.com/Questie/Questie/wiki/FAQ)
* Come chat with us on [our Discord server](https://discord.gg/s33MAYKeZd) .
* You can use the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Questie/Questie/issues) to report bugs and post feature requests (requires a GitHub account).
* When creating an issue please follow the templated structure to speed up a possible fix.
* If you get an error message from the WoW client, please include the **complete** text or a screenshot of it in your report.
  
    + You need to enter `/console scriptErrors 1` once in the ingame chat for Lua error messages to be shown. You can later disable them again with `/console scriptErrors 0` .

Trust us it's (Good)!

## Languages

...

* We are happy about every help and contribution we get, so feel free to submit a Pull Request on GitHub
* Additional information you might find interesting can be found [here](https://github.com/Questie/Questie/wiki/Contributing)

### Installing Lua

1. Install [Lua](https://www.lua.org/download.html) (5.1, since the WoW client uses Lua 5.1)
   
    + For macOS that is `brew install lua@5.1`
2. Install [luarocks](https://luarocks.org/)
   
    + For macOS that is `brew install luarocks`
3. Configure `luarocks` to use the correct Lua version (by default luarocks uses the latest installed Lua version)
   
    + `luarocks config lua_version 5.1`
4. Install [busted](https://github.com/lunarmodules/busted)
   
    + `luarocks install busted`
5. Install `bit32`
   
    + `luarocks install bit32`
6. Install [luacheck](https://github.com/lunarmodules/luacheck)
   
    + `luarocks install luacheck`

### luacheck

Questie uses `luacheck` for linting. You can run it locally with:
`luacheck -q Database Localization Modules Questie.lua`

### Unit Tests

1. Run `busted -p ".test.lua" .` in the root directory of the project
2. When adding new tests, make sure to name them `<module>.test.lua` and place them next to the module

### Database validation

There is a validation script for every expansion that checks the database for common errors. That way we try to keep data as correct as possible, and we don't forget to adjust the `NPC.questStarts` field when we adjust `Quest.startedBy` . You can run the scripts with:

`lua cli/validate-<expansion>.lua`

Replace `<expansion>` with the expansion you want to validate (check the `cli` folder for available scripts).

## Donation

If you'd like to support the development of Questie by donating, you can do so via PayPal:

## Integrate Questie into your addon

Checkout the [README of the Questie API](https://github.com/Questie/Questie/blob/master/Public/README.md) .

## Features

### Show quests on map
* Show notes for quest start points, turn in points, and objectives.
* Waypoint lines for NPCs showing their pathing.

[Questie Quest Givers](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/ba90ff1f6d74de5aa5ce10207da1360c693a025db782755f5fc348025a1f5808/68747470733a2f2f692e696d6775722e636f6d2f346162693579752e706e67) [Questie Complete](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/b90a42f5bbd562a46d020c3b799c336a0bc705648a43a269cd661dfa2f47578b/68747470733a2f2f692e696d6775722e636f6d2f446776424879682e706e67) [Questie Tooltip](https://camo.githubusercontent.com/9c0f92cd8a5aecbcb2e692aad70f7fc3cfc1b28cf9e5c25a27bce3be26c0dbee/68747470733a2f2f692e696d6775722e636f6d2f7550796b484b432e706e67)

### Quest Tracker

* Automatically tracks quests on accepting
* Can show all quests from the log at once (instead of default 5)
* Left click quest to open quest log (configurable)
* Right-click for more options, e.g.:

    + Point arrow towards objective (requires [TomTom addon](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/tomtom) )

* Questie's database can be searched. (left-click on minimap button (or type `/questie journey` ) and select the "Advances Search" tab)

# Export -> Import breaks strings

- Page: GitHub issue
- URL: https://github.com/WeakAuras/WeakAuras2/issues/94
- State: closed (completed)
- Author: redfellow
- Created: 2016-08-17T21:43:15Z
- Updated: 2016-08-28T16:10:07Z
- Repository: WeakAuras/WeakAuras2
- Number: #94
- Comments: 15

---

I have multiple strings that users are reporting throwing out errors. They work on my PC, unless I export the string and re-import it.

First string loses every % character from: 
- Display tab Text input box (says only `c` now).
- Custom Trigger 1 code
- Custom Trigger 2 code
- Actions onInit code

Code DIFF screenshot: http://i.imgur.com/QDceLwV.png

Second string suddenly gains a lot of apostrophes in places that there shouldn't be any, another DIFF screenshot: http://i.imgur.com/iTX2sjL.png

## Timeline

**redfellow** commented on 2016-08-17T21:47:22Z:

> Here's a one of those groups, requires lvl 100 Vengeance DH http://pastebin.com/KWZ3ePn6
>
> If I only import the large custom function icon display, the bug does not persist. 
>
> Edit: I managed to get 2/3 of the strings to export/import after removing a couple of empty lines and code comments. For example: http://i.imgur.com/MNv4SDV.png

**InfusOnWoW** commented on 2016-08-17T22:41:36Z:

> Please attach your WeakAuras.lua that reproduces the problem.

**Stanzilla** commented on 2016-08-17T22:47:53Z:

> Info: we're currently suspecting a problem in LibCompress

**redfellow** commented on 2016-08-18T07:39:09Z:

> How to reproduce with my WeakAuras.lua using Havoc specced Demon Hunter at lvl 100: 
>
> http://redlan.co/2016-08-18_10-35-38.mp4
> http://redlan.co/WeakAurasOptions.lua
> http://redlan.co/WeakAuras.lua
>
> You can probably reproduce this on any other class too. Easiest way to see that it's broken down after import is that the group name has changed from "Redfella's..." to "Redfellas" and in the custom code apostrophes and percentage signs are gone mental.
>
> Edit:
>
> Here are the lua files again after I fixed the string, simply by adding one apostrophe to the group name. This kind of "fixes" are bandainds though, a tweak here or there will again break the string and adding a random change to the string may or may not fix it again.
>
> http://redlan.co/fixed_WeakAurasOptions.lua
> http://redlan.co/fixed_WeakAuras.lua

**InfusOnWoW** commented on 2016-08-18T17:35:54Z:

> So, I'm traveling at the moment, but from your description you can reproduce that even over multiple restarts of the WoW client, right?

**Stanzilla** commented on 2016-08-18T17:53:48Z:

> with the WA I posted on the wowace ticket (https://www.wowace.com/addons/weakauras-2/tickets/573-exports-convert-all-logical-into-assignments/) I can reproduce it every time.
> It's not only happening for `'` it's also `>` and possibly other special chars.

**redfellow** commented on 2016-08-18T18:07:58Z:
> Restarts and reload UI do not resolve the erroneous state, only modifying the group does -- and a minor modification may break it again once the string has reached a state where it's developed this behaviour.
>
> What I find strange is that I've ever only had this happen to a single string at a time, but this time it started to affect all 4 of my Rotation Helpers during the course of one day, I did update WA to a newer version but I also did minor modifications to all of them (not same edits, though).

**Stanzilla** commented on 2016-08-20T00:57:13Z:

> Infus found the issue and we are now in talks with the owner of the compress library we are using since it looks like the bug is in there, will keep you updated.

**redfellow** commented on 2016-08-20T07:01:53Z:

> Awesome!

**redfellow** commented on 2016-08-26T17:00:49Z:

> Any update?
>
> Would love to start releasing updates to the strings I have, that are affected by the bug.

**Stanzilla** commented on 2016-08-26T17:02:16Z:

...

**redfellow** commented on 2016-08-28T16:10:07Z:

> I just exported all of my strings, and upon re-importing none of them were broken.

# [omekinteractive](https://omekinteractive.com)

+ [ElvUI](https://omekinteractive.com/elvui-my-setup-install-and-best-settings/)
    + [Meet the Author](https://omekinteractive.com/meet-the-author/)
    + [My Contacts](https://omekinteractive.com/my-contacts/)
    + [Privacy Policy](https://omekinteractive.com/privacy-policy/)

Get Started

# ElvUI

Hi, I’m Danny Hansen from **omekinteractive.com** . This page walks you through how I install ElvUI, the settings I use, and quick fixes for common problems. The goal is simple: a clean UI that shows what matters in dungeons, raids, Mythic+, and PvP without extra clutter.

## What ElvUI Does (in plain terms)

* Replaces the default UI with a clean layout
* Lets you move, resize, and skin almost everything
* Packs bags, nameplates, unit frames, action bars, and buff tracking into one addon
* Reduces the number of addons you need

* * *

## How to Install ElvUI (safe method)

1. **Download from Tukui:** Go to tukui.
org → “ElvUI” → download the latest release (zip).
2. **Unzip:** Extract the folder(s) `ElvUI` and `ElvUI_OptionsUI` .
3. **Add to AddOns:** Copy both into `…/World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/` .
4. **Enable in-game:** On the character screen → AddOns → check **ElvUI** and **ElvUI\_OptionsUI** .
5. **Enter the game:** The setup wizard appears. If not, type `/ec` then click “Reset Anchors” or “Install”.

**Tip:** Keep a copy of your `WTF` and `Interface` folders before big patches.

* * *

## First-Run Setup Wizard (my choices)

When ElvUI asks for defaults, here’s what I pick:

* **CVars:** Yes
* **Chat:** Yes (clean timestamps and tabs)
* **Layout:** Healer for healers; DPS/Tank for everyone else
* **Auras:** Enable
* **ActionBars:** Enable
* **NamePlates:** Enable
* **Skins:** Enable

You can change anything later with `/ec` .

* * *

## Profile Management (save, share, restore)

* **Save your profile:** `/ec` → Profiles → “New” → name it (e.g.
, “Omek-Core”).
* **Set per-class variants:** Create a second profile like “Omek-Healer” or “Omek-M+”.
* **Backup:** Copy `WTF/Account/<YourAccount>/SavedVariables/ElvUI.lua` somewhere safe.
* **Import:** `/ec` → Profiles → Import Profile → paste string → Import.
* **Export:** `/ec` → Profiles → Export Profile (choose “Profile” + “LuaTable”) → Save.

* * *

## My Core Layout (high-visibility, low-clutter)

### UI Scale and Fonts

* **ESC → System → Graphics → UI Scale:** 0\.80–0.90 (adjust for monitor size)
* **ElvUI → General → Media:** Pick one easy-to-read font; keep size consistent

### Action Bars

* **Bars Enabled:** 1–4 only (fewer bars = less noise)
* **Buttons per Bar:** 12
* **Button Size:** 30–34 px (bigger if you miss keys)
* **Mouseover Bars:** For crafting/toys
* **Keybinds:** Keep defensives and interrupts in reach; put long CDs on a top or right bar

### Unit Frames
* **Player/Target:** Center-bottom, near character feet but not covering them
* **Castbar:** Thick, just under player frame; show ticks for channeled spells
* **Target of Target:** Small, tucked near target
* **Focus:** Right side of target; bind a “Set Focus” macro for bosses/adds
* **Pet:** Only if the spec needs it
* **Class Power:** Right below the player frame (energy, holy power, etc.)

**Settings path:** `/ec` → UnitFrames

* Health text: **percent**
* Name text: **class color**
* Buffs/debuffs: Only show **my important debuffs** on target

### Raid/Party Frames

* **Position:** Left side, mid-height
* **Growth:** Down, 5–8 rows
* **Indicators:** Show dispellable debuffs and major raid mechanics
* **Role icons:** On
* **Mana bars:** Healer specs only
* **Click-casting:** Use ElvUI or Clique (keep it simple)

### Nameplates

* **Friendly:** Smaller; show important buffs (Bloodlust, externals)
* **Enemy:** Clear castbar, big interrupt shield, show **only key auras**
* **Stacking:** Overlapping nameplates **off** for dungeons; **on** if you prefer
* **Color by threat:** Tank: green when safe, red when losing aggro. DPS: red when over-aggro.

**Path:** `/ec` → NamePlates

* Style Filters: Add rules to enlarge priority mobs or affix spawns

### Auras (Buffs/Debuffs)

* **Buffs:** Top-right; 2 rows; 12 icons per row
* **Debuffs:** Below buffs; large scale
* **Duration text:** On
* **Whitelist:** Keep it tight—CDs and vital procs only

### Chat

* **Left Chat:** General/Guild/Whispers
* **Right Chat:** Combat Log
* **Timestamps:** On; short format
* **Loot/Trade spam:** Move to a separate tab

### Bags

* **One bag:** On
* **Sorting:** By item quality and type
* **Search bar:** On
* **Junk sell:** Enable auto-sell gray + auto-repair (guild first)

### Tooltips

* **Anchor:** Cursor or bottom-right
* **Show:** Item level, mythic+ level, target-of-target
* **Hide in combat:** Optional for healers/DPS to reduce noise

* * *

## My Role-Based Tweaks

### Mythic+ Focus
* Enlarge **interruptible casts** on nameplates
* Show **affix** icons (via plugin or WA)
* Keep **Focus** on the most dangerous caster; make focus castbar large
* Action Bar: Put interrupts/stuns front-center

### Raid Comfort

* Raid frames closer to center (less eye travel)
* Boss frames stacked on the right; timers near boss frames
* Personal CDs (e.g., healthstone, defensives) grouped and large

### PvP Readiness

* Show enemy **trinket** \+ **CC** icons on nameplates (via plugin)
* Focus target big castbar; set focus on key healer
* Thin borders; strong class colors

* * *

## Lightweight Plugins I Like (optional)

* **ElvUI WindTools** — extra quality-of-life options
* **ElvUI Shadow & Light** — more customization and utilities
* **ElvUI AutoQuest** (or similar) — speeds up world content
* **AddOnSkins** — skins for DBM/Details!/WA so the look matches

_(Install from trusted sources. Keep versions current.)_

* * *

## Performance Tips
* **ElvUI → General → BlizzHUD:** Disable pieces you don’t need
* **Nameplates:** Reduce animations and glow if FPS dips
* **UnitFrame update rate:** Keep default unless you need ultra-fast updates
* **Texture choices:** Simple textures render faster
* **Disable what you don’t use:** Modules like Datatexts you never read can be off

* * *

## Troubleshooting (fast fixes)

* **UI looks broken after a patch:**
  
    1. Update ElvUI; 2) `/reload` ; 3) Reset anchors in `/ec`
* **Profile won’t load:**  
  Check `/ec → Profiles` and verify you’re on the right character/spec profile
* **Nameplates missing:**  
  Press **V** (default). Then `/ec → NamePlates → Enable` . Check CVars: `/run SetCVar("nameplateShowEnemies",1)`
* **Chat reset:**  
  `/ec → Chat → Reset Position` . Lock tabs to prevent dragging
* **Action bar clicks off by one:**  
  Disable “Action Paging” or keybind mode, rebind with `/kb`
* **Big FPS drops:**
Lower nameplate density; turn off combat text in ElvUI; reduce shadow/outline fonts

# Questie Addon Guide — Download, Install, Setup & Settings

**Questie** is the essential quest helper addon for WoW Classic and TBC Classic Anniversary, designed to remove the guesswork from leveling. Vanilla and TBC quests were never built with modern quality-of-life in mind — objectives are vague, NPC locations are unmarked, and tracking turn-ins across multiple zones can quickly become a headache. Questie solves all of this by placing quest givers, objectives, and turn-in NPCs directly on your map and minimap.

In this guide, we’ll cover what Questie does, how to install and configure it, and how to get the most out of its tracking, map, and database features. 🗺️

## What Is Questie?

Questie is a quest helper addon that adds available quests, objectives, and turn-in locations directly to your map and minimap.

...

## How to Configure Questie

On first login, Questie will run a short setup wizard. After that, you can access full settings anytime by clicking the Questie icon on your minimap.

### 🛠️ Basic Setup

* **Left-click** the minimap button to open the configuration menu
* **Right-click** the minimap button to open the searchable quest/item/NPC database
* Choose which quest types to track: available, active, or completed
* Set how many quests can be tracked on your screen at once

### ⚡ Quick Settings for Map & Minimap

* Adjust the **icon scale** so markers stay readable without cluttering your map
* Enable or disable icons for quest givers, turn-ins, mobs, and gathering objectives separately
* Set a **draw distance** so only nearby quest icons appear, reducing visual noise in busy zones

### 🎯 Tips for Tracking & Journey

* Use the **Tracker** window to pin your most important quests to the screen
* Open the **Journey** tab to see a full breakdown of completed vs.

...

### Can I reduce the number of icons Questie shows on my map?

Yes, the configuration menu lets you toggle icon types individually and adjust draw distance and icon scale to reduce clutter.
